messages:
hana: Quick note  I'm proposing a targeted refactor I'm calling 'stitchless shear' — carve a thin, well-documented interface around session & cache responsibilities so we can retire ad-hoc cross-calls. Not a giant extract, iterative shards. Sync tomorrow?

omar: +1. Can we scope to the minimal surface that touches the token hotpath? i.e., session lease, kv-get/put, and tenant headers.

lucy: agree. keep payload unchanged. plan: facade that forwards to either legacy or sheared tile based on header X-Shear-Ver.

frank: perf concern: batching. if we scatter, batch sizes will shrink. proposal: batching shim in facade for initial rollout, move to tile-local batching later.

hana: migration sketch: 1) add facade + feature flag 2) implement tile prototype behind flag 3) single-tenant canary -> cohort rollout. auto-rollback on SLO regressions.

omar: acceptance criteria: p95 delta <=5% on hotpath, p99 token-loop <=3% increase, per-tenant rollback <=5m, and no telemetry schema changes.

lucy: tests: semantic diff on canonical prompts, migration chaos (kill tile during warm), and batch-size distribution checks.

ci-bot: schedule created: staging canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC. tag branches with "stitchless-shear".

frank: ops runbook must include warm-up, placement APIs, and eviction grace for migrating tenants. we'll also need dashboards for shard.hit_rate and shard.batch.size.

hana: owners: lucy (compat + tests), omar (placement + leases), frank (ops + dashboards). I'll write RFC and link. Thanks all.
